query=query PullRequestThreads($owner: String!, $name: String!, $number: Int!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { pullRequest(number: $number) { reviewThreads(first: 100) { nodes { id isResolved isOutdated comments(first: 100) { nodes { id body createdAt updatedAt url author { login } path line originalLine diffSide } } } } } } }
